shortDescription: Brocade Fibre Channel zoning default zone configuration

options.name: default_zone_access
options.description: Default zone access mode. "allaccess" to indicate all access "noaccess" to indicate no access.

options.name: throttle
options.description: Throttling delay in seconds. Enables second retry on first failure.

options.name: timeout
options.description: REST timeout in seconds for operations that take longer than FOS default value.

options.name: vfid
options.description: VFID of the switch. Use -1 for FOS without VF enabled or AG.
